public.text: The Facility Registry is said to cross-reference the Client Registry to record facilities attended by a person. Attendance history is clinical or encounter information and should not normally be held in the Facility Registry.
public.suggestedRevision: Remove this statement. Facility attendance should be represented in encounter, service-use, or LHR data referencing both the person and facility identifiers.
